note: Adapted from entry 300 in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; that entry describes the nominotypical subspecies N. matangensis matangensis; the morphology of the other subspecies is not given in the source and has not been supplied; no nymph. Synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated; the alate head length is given in the source as 1.3.0, an OCR corruption, and is not recorded.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish yellow with a reddish tinge to chestnut brown; fontanelle gland area paler; nasus brown, darker near the apex; antennae brownish yellow; abdominal tergites brown to rusty brown; legs and sternites cream-coloured. Vertex with 1 pair of long setae and base of the nasus with 1 pair of long setae, sometimes with several additional ones, without microscopic setae; abdominal tergites bare, sternites with short setae. Body length 4.00–5.30 mm. Head thick and broad, transversely oval, wider than the length without nasus (length with nasus 1.90–2.10, length without nasus 1.10–1.30, width 1.30–1.50 mm); in lateral view nearly straight, nasus hump absent. Nasus short, conical, robust, hairy at the apex (length 0.70–0.85 mm, nasus length/head length index 0.58–0.68). Antennae 13–14-segmented (usually 13-segmented); segment 3 almost twice as long as segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 2 (13-segmented antenna); in the 14-segmented antenna segment 3 nearly equal to segment 2. Mandibles reduced, each with a short brown spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.30–0.35, width 0.60–0.65 mm); anterior margin rounded, not or only weakly concave; posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown to smoky brown; pronotum paler than the head; antennae and postclypeus straw-coloured; abdominal tergites light brown, sternites yellowish white. Head sparsely hairy, body moderately hairy. Body length 4.00–5.50 mm. Head nearly square and rounded (length to the base of the mandibles 1.20, width 1.44 mm); coronal suture faintly visible. Fontanelle spot narrowly elongate-oval. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 much longer than segment 2, segment 4 nearly equal to segment 2. Postclypeus short, swollen, hairy; less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.30, width 0.95 mm); anterior margin distinctly notched, posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule chestnut brown; antennae and postclypeus brownish; pronotum deep straw-coloured to light brown; sternites light brown. Head and body densely hairy; distal half of the wing with short setae. Body length with wings 16.50–17.00, without wings 7.50–8.50 mm. Head nearly circular (width including eyes 1.70–1.79 mm); coronal suture absent. Fontanelle plate slightly elongate, translucent, narrow. Eyes large, nearly circular, projecting (maximum diameter 0.60 mm). Ocelli large, oval (long diameter 0.20 mm), adjacent to the compound eyes, almost touching them (eye–ocellus distance 0.025 mm). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus weakly swollen, hairy; less than half as long as wide. Pronotum trapezoidal (length 0.80–0.84, width 1.30–1.40 mm); anterior margin slightly raised, not concave; posterior margin slightly concave. Wings straw-coloured, membrane hairy; microstructure consisting of papillae on the anterior and posterior margins and of fine stellate and non-stellate (5–7 arms) microsetae; fore wing length 14.0–14.50 mm, hind wing length 14.0 mm.
